Grad Café Analytics

A small data service that scrapes graduate-admission results from Grad Café, stores them in PostgreSQL, and shows an analysis page with Pull Data and Update Analysis buttons. Module 4 of Modern Software Concepts in Python (Johns Hopkins University) adds a test suite with 100% coverage, a GitHub Actions pipeline, and this documentation.

Caleb Gevertz (JHED: cgevert1)
